description: The plot illustrates the relationship between activated parameters ratio and eval PPL for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL” and has a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  A dashed red line, labeled “Transformer”, begins at approximately (100, 11.6) and ends at approximately (25, 11.6), remaining relatively constant across the x-axis. A solid gray line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD FFN”, begins at approximately (100, 11.7) and ends at approximately (25, 12.2), showing a gradual increase. A solid blue line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD ATTN”, begins at approximately (100, 11.6) and ends at approximately (25, 13.1), showing a gradual increase. A solid cyan line with cross markers, labeled “MoHD ATTN + MLP”, begins at approximately (100, 11.5) and ends at approximately (25, 13.2), showing a gradual increase.
